clips.title: The story
paras: This critical phase of the Forsaken campaign in Hillsbrad targets the dwarven stronghold of Dun Garok. High Executor Darthalia dispatches Horde champions to dismantle the dwarven garrison assisting the local humans and execute their commanding officer, Captain Ironhill.

Having pressured the human farmers and town militia across the foothills, High Executor Darthalia turns Tarren Mill's fury against Ironforge's military contingent. Dwarven troops have taken up arms in support of Southshore, reinforcing the human presence in Lordaeron. To Darthalia, this solidarity is an obstacle that must be shattered, proving to the Alliance that aiding the human remnants will bring only devastation.

Tucked against the ancient ramparts of Thoradin's Wall in southeastern Hillsbrad, Dun Garok serves as a heavily fortified dwarven bastion. Storming the outpost requires breaking through ranks of disciplined mountaineers, crack riflemen, and battle-hardened priests. The assault culminates in the death of Captain Ironhill, breaking Ironforge's forward tactical command in the region and leaving the remaining human enclaves isolated.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Dwarves aiding the humans? Damn those filthy little beasts.

We shall test the strength of the so-called Alliance. We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath. We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.

They have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok. The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, adventurer. Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Dun Garok proves to be too much of an obstacle for you, adventurer? And here I thought you had established yourself valiantly in Hillsbrad.

If you're not up to handle the mission assigned to you, I will find another who can produce better results. As for you, well, I am sure the Dark Lady could always use more grave diggers back in Tirisfal Glades.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your actions on the battlefield are worthy of the highest praise.
